name: dsq
description: Command-line tool for running SQL queries against JSON, CSV, Excel, Parquet, and more

dsq.description: DataStation Query - SQL queries against structured data files with automatic schema detection and format conversion
dsq.usage: dsq data.csv 'SELECT * FROM {} LIMIT 10'\ndsq data.json 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {}'\ndsq file.xlsx 'SELECT column1, column2 FROM {} WHERE column1 > 100'
